checks.name: Checkpoint records a JSON-safe draft with canonical IDs and decision evidence
An actual component remount restores the same aircraft paused without advancing time or fuel
Menu Resume restores the saved shift paused and keeps its career totals uncommitted
Discard removes an unfinished draft without committing its score, landings, or history
Unsupported and invalid drafts safely return to the menu and can be discarded
Completed and skipped math restore to their worked example without awarding points twice
Ending a restored shift commits once, clears the draft, and retains its decision evidence
History reopens either debrief and restores a separate saved reflection for each shift
Viewing an earlier debrief cannot replace an unfinished active shift
Flight-strip priority order stays stable while focused, then updates after leaving the list
Math, strips, and command controls precede forecasts in both DOM and visible layout
No uncaught browser errors or native prompt dialogs during recovery and history
